id: 05_Risk Assessment, their steps, safety assessment & typical issues of GMOs part4 m
title: 转基因生物：先评估，再放行（国内版）
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/05_Risk Assessment, their steps, safety assessment & typical issues of GMOs part4 m.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/05_Risk Assessment, their steps, safety assessment & typical issues of GMOs part4 m（国内版）/src.py

points.K4: 改基因，就能改性状和蛋白
points.K6: 上市前评价：系统、综合、逐案
points.K10: 第一阶段：和非转基因的比一比
points.K11: 第二阶段：差异影响多大
points.K12: 评价要点一：说清这个生物
points.S1: 国内法规：依法评价，按规标识
points.S2: 工程菌株和载体：登记在册，不私转
points.S3: 意外逸出：控住现场，立即报告

shots.scene: 欣欣站在温室和实验台之间向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between a small greenhouse and a lab bench and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲转基因生物的安全评价。
overlay: 转基因生物：先评估，再放行

shots.scene: 一株植物、一个培养皿和一个对勾盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a potted plant, a petri dish and a shield with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 先评估，再放行。

shots.scene: 阿杰在实验室门口端着一盆幼苗，想往外走
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks toward the lab door carrying a small potted seedling with a blank tag.
shots.narration: 阿杰想把一盆转基因幼苗带回宿舍养。

shots.scene: 小研伸手拦住，指着空白登记本
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him with a raised hand and points to a blank logbook on the bench.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：它评估过了吗？

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，欣欣出现在一旁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head while the panda mascot appears beside them.
shots.narration: 阿杰愣住了，我们从头说起。

shots.scene: 两个细胞图标，一段彩色基因从左边移到右边
shots.prompt_en: Two cell icons; a small colored gene segment moves from the left cell into the right cell. No people.
shots.narration: 基因改造，是一种生物技术。

shots.scene: 箭头把一段基因从供体生物送到受体生物
shots.prompt_en: An arrow carries a gene segment from a donor organism icon to a recipient organism icon. No people.
shots.narration: 把一种生物的基因，转入另一种生物。

shots.scene: 一株普通植物旁长出一株叶色不同的新植株
shots.prompt_en: An ordinary plant icon next to a new plant icon with leaves of a different color. No people.
shots.narration: 受体的生长发育，会因此改变。

shots.scene: 新品种植物和动物的图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a new plant variety, a fish and a small farm animal, each with a sparkle. No people.
shots.narration: 于是有了新的植物和动物品种。

shots.scene: DNA 双螺旋上被替换进一段不同颜色的片段
shots.prompt_en: A DNA double helix with one segment replaced by a differently colored piece. No people.
shots.narration: 转基因生物，遗传物质被改变过，

shots.scene: 实验台上一组空白试管和质粒环形图标
shots.prompt_en: Blank test tubes on a bench next to a circular plasmid icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用的是重组 DNA 技术。

shots.section_title: 改基因，就能改性状和蛋白
shots.scene: 基因图标指向一片叶子形状的变化
shots.prompt_en: A gene icon with an arrow pointing to a leaf that changes shape. No people.
shots.narration: 改了基因，性状就可能不同，
overlay: 改基因，就能改性状和蛋白

shots.section_title: 改基因，就能改性状和蛋白
shots.scene: 基因图标指向一个蛋白质分子图标
shots.prompt_en: A gene icon with an arrow pointing to a folded protein molecule icon. No people.
shots.narration: 产生的蛋白质也会不同。

shots.scene: 转基因植物站在实验室门口，门外是田野
shots.prompt_en: A potted plant icon stands at an open lab door; beyond the door are fields and a village. No people.
shots.narration: 转基因生物要走出实验室之前，

shots.scene: 天平一边是环境图标，一边是人的图标
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with an environment icon on one side and a person outline on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 先评估对环境和人有什么风险。

shots.section_title: 上市前评价：系统、综合、逐案
shots.scene: 老周和王老师在会议桌前翻看空白资料夹
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the safety administrator sit at a meeting table reviewing blank folders.
shots.narration: 上市前的评价，要按体系来做，
overlay: 上市前评价：系统、综合、逐案

shots.section_title: 上市前评价：系统、综合、逐案
shots.scene: 资料夹一个个分开，每个贴一个不同图标
shots.prompt_en: Several blank folders laid out separately, each with a different plant or microbe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 综合考虑，一个一个单独评价。

shots.scene: 四个相连的方块图标：放大镜、尺子、人群、仪表盘
shots.prompt_en: Four connected icons: a magnifying glass, a ruler, a group of people and a risk dial. No people.
shots.narration: 风险评估有四个组成部分。

shots.scene: 放大镜对着一株植物找出一个警示点
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a plant icon reveals a small warning dot. No people.
shots.narration: 先识别危害，再描述它的特征，

shots.scene: 人群图标和仪表盘指针
shots.prompt_en: A group of person outlines next to a dial with a needle moving between low and high. No people.
shots.narration: 看接触多少，最后描述风险大小。

shots.scene: 小研在白板上画三个箭头相连的方框
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student draws three boxes linked by arrows on a whiteboard, the boxes left blank.
shots.narration: 具体顺序分三步。

shots.scene: 放大镜标出一个可能有害的特性图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass highlights one trait icon with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 找出可能带来不良影响的特性，

shots.scene: 警示特性连出一串后果图标
shots.prompt_en: The warning trait icon links by arrows to several consequence icons. No people.
shots.narration: 评价它可能造成什么后果，

shots.scene: 每个特性旁一个概率骰子和风险条
shots.prompt_en: Each trait icon has a small dice and a short risk bar beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 再估计每一项发生的可能和风险。

shots.scene: 五级台阶，每级一个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five steps of a staircase, each with an icon: magnifying glass, people, scale, notebook, circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 通用的风险评估，也可以走五步。

shots.scene: 放大镜和人群图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass icon followed by a group of person outlines. No people.
shots.narration: 找危害，想清谁会受害、怎么受害，

shots.scene: 天平和打勾的防护措施清单
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale next to a blank checklist with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 评估风险，定下防护措施，

shots.scene: 小研在空白评估表上填写并签字
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills in and signs a blank assessment form at her desk.
shots.narration: 把结果记下来，并照着做，

shots.scene: 循环箭头围着一张评估表
shots.prompt_en: A circular arrow around a blank assessment form. No people.
shots.narration: 定期复查，必要时更新。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前点头，两套框架并排
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a whiteboard showing two short flowcharts side by side.
shots.narration: 两套说法，思路是一样的。

shots.section_title: 第一阶段：和非转基因的比一比
shots.scene: 转基因玉米和普通玉米并排放在实验台上
shots.prompt_en: Two corn cobs on a bench side by side, one with a small blue dot tag and one plain. No people.
shots.narration: 安全评价分两个阶段。
overlay: 第一阶段：和非转基因的比一比

shots.section_title: 第一阶段：和非转基因的比一比
shots.scene: 小研对照两份空白数据表找不同
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares two blank data sheets with a magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 先和对应的非转基因品种比较，

shots.section_title: 第一阶段：和非转基因的比一比
shots.scene: 两份图表中有一处用圆圈标出
shots.prompt_en: Two simple bar chart icons; one bar is circled in red where they differ. No people.
shots.narration: 找出它们之间的差异。

shots.section_title: 第二阶段：差异影响多大
shots.scene: 圈出的差异连向环境、餐盘、营养三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The circled difference links by arrows to three icons: a field, a dinner plate and a nutrition label pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 再评价这些差异的影响，
overlay: 第二阶段：差异影响多大

shots.section_title: 第二阶段：差异影响多大
shots.scene: 一个靶心图标和一个问号图标
shots.prompt_en: A target icon labeled with a check and a question mark icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 对环境、食品安全和营养各有多大。

shots.section_title: 第二阶段：差异影响多大
shots.scene: 欣欣举起两根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up two fingers.
shots.narration: 预期的和意外的差异，都要看。

shots.section_title: 评价要点一：说清这个生物
shots.scene: 三色表格，第一行亮起
shots.prompt_en: A blank three-row table in gray, orange and red; the gray row lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 评价时要考虑三类问题。
overlay: 评价要点一：说清这个生物

shots.section_title: 评价要点一：说清这个生物
shots.scene: 供体和受体两个生物图标，各附一张空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: A donor organism icon and a recipient organism icon, each with a blank info card. No people.
shots.narration: 第一，供体和受体各是什么生物，

shots.section_title: 评价要点一：说清这个生物
shots.scene: 一段基因连到一个齿轮图标
shots.prompt_en: A gene segment connected to a working gear icon. No people.
shots.narration: 改了什么基因，起什么作用。

shots.scene: 表格第二行亮起，田野和小动物图标
shots.prompt_en: The orange row lights up next to icons of a field, bees and small wild animals. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，环境安全。

shots.scene: 受体植物旁两个箭头：一个打勾，一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A recipient plant icon with two arrows: one to a green check, one to a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 改造带来哪些预期和意外的变化，

shots.scene: 田野生态图标上放一个放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a small ecosystem icon of plants, insects and soil. No people.
shots.narration: 对生态环境可能有什么影响。

shots.scene: 表格第三行亮起，餐盘和饲料桶图标
shots.prompt_en: The red row lights up next to icons of a dinner plate and an animal feed bucket. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，食品安全。

shots.scene: 营养成分饼图和一个蛋白质图标
shots.prompt_en: A nutrition pie chart icon next to a protein molecule icon with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 成分营养如何，新蛋白有没有毒性，

shots.scene: 一个打喷嚏的人形图标和一口锅
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a person outline sneezing and a cooking pot with steam. No people.
shots.narration: 会不会致敏，加工后有没有变化，

shots.scene: 日历图标和饭碗图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon next to a rice bowl and a scale icon. No people.
shots.narration: 吃的量会不会变，长期营养影响。

shots.section_title: 国内法规：依法评价，按规标识
shots.scene: 王老师拿着两本空白封面的法规文本
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds up two law books with blank covers.
shots.narration: 在国内，转基因有专门的法规。
overlay: 国内法规：依法评价，按规标识

shots.section_title: 国内法规：依法评价，按规标识
shots.scene: 台阶图标分几级，每级一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A staircase icon with several levels, each with a shield of a different size. No people.
shots.narration: 依法做安全评价，按等级管理。

shots.section_title: 国内法规：依法评价，按规标识
shots.scene: 超市货架上的商品贴着空白标识
shots.prompt_en: Products on a supermarket shelf with a small blank label pictogram on each package. No people.
shots.narration: 上市的产品，还要按规定标识。

shots.section_title: 国内法规：依法评价，按规标识
shots.scene: 空白文件上盖章图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank document with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 条款和程序，以现行文本为准。

shots.section_title: 工程菌株和载体：登记在册，不私转
shots.scene: 冰箱里的冻存盒，旁边一本空白登记册
shots.prompt_en: A lab freezer rack of cryo boxes with blank labels next to a blank inventory logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里的工程菌株和载体，
overlay: 工程菌株和载体：登记在册，不私转

shots.section_title: 工程菌株和载体：登记在册，不私转
shots.scene: 小研在登记册上记录，老周签字
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes in the inventory logbook while the older man signs beside her.
shots.narration: 要登记在册，专人保管。

shots.section_title: 工程菌株和载体：登记在册，不私转
shots.scene: 两只手私下交接一支管子，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Two hands passing a small tube privately, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能私下送人、带走或寄出。

shots.section_title: 工程菌株和载体：登记在册，不私转
shots.scene: 老周把空白申请表交给王老师
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands a blank request form to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 转移给别人，先报批，再交接。

shots.section_title: 工程菌株和载体：登记在册，不私转
shots.scene: 阿杰把幼苗放回温室，小研点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts the seedling back in the lab growth chamber; the female graduate student nods.
shots.narration: 阿杰的幼苗，也要留在实验室。

shots.section_title: 意外逸出：控住现场，立即报告
shots.scene: 培养瓶倒在台面上，液体洒开
shots.prompt_en: A culture flask tipped over on the bench with liquid spreading. No people.
shots.narration: 转基因材料万一洒出、丢失，
overlay: 意外逸出：控住现场，立即报告

shots.section_title: 意外逸出：控住现场，立即报告
shots.scene: 小研戴手套，用吸水纸覆盖洒溢处
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in gloves and lab coat covers the spill with absorbent paper.
shots.narration: 先控制现场，按规程消毒清理。

shots.section_title: 意外逸出：控住现场，立即报告
shots.scene: 小研打电话报告老周
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call to the older man.
shots.narration: 立即报告实验室负责人，

shots.section_title: 意外逸出：控住现场，立即报告
shots.scene: 电话连线学院和学校安全部门图标
shots.prompt_en: A phone icon linked to icons of a department building and a campus safety office. No people.
shots.narration: 再逐级报告学院和学校。

shots.section_title: 意外逸出：控住现场，立即报告
shots.scene: 空白记录表上写下时间图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank incident record form with a clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 如实记录经过，不隐瞒。

shots.scene: 两排台阶图标，一排向上一排向下
shots.prompt_en: Two staircase icons side by side: on one the danger arrow rises from step one to four, on the other it falls. No people.
shots.narration: 下一课讲危险度分组和防护分级。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着国内一侧台阶的最高处
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to the top step of one staircase icon marked with a red warning triangle.
shots.narration: 记住：国内第一类最危险，方向相反。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现 DNA、放大镜、天平图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a DNA helix, a magnifying glass and a balance scale.
shots.narration: 转基因生物，释放前先评估。

shots.scene: 四方块与五级台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of four connected boxes and a five-step staircase. No people.
shots.narration: 识别危害、描述特征、评估风险。

shots.scene: 比较与评价两个阶段图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: two corn cobs being compared, then arrows to a field and a dinner plate. No people.
shots.narration: 先比差异，再看对环境和食品的影响。

shots.scene: 登记册和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an inventory logbook with a green check and a phone. No people.
shots.narration: 材料登记不私转，出了意外就报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研在实验室挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the young male student and the female graduate student in the lab.
shots.narration: 依法评价，守好实验室，下次见！
